description: An invalid template in the result makes a call of the function fail
notes: The JSON spec makes a string a template when it is evaluated, so the invalid template is an error in evaluating the result. The spec doesn't say what happens when a function fails (see native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error). hashicorp/hcl returns the diagnostics of evaluating the result expression as the function's error, first from the type callback that go-cty calls before the implementation (spec.Type in decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), and FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go reports an error from a function as an error in the call.
